description: Per-skill evaluation for flutter-developer — validates trigger routing, negative triggers, anti-pattern compliance, and checklist coverage.

scenarios.description: Agent should activate flutter-developer for a Flutter performance request
scenarios.input: Our Flutter app janks on scroll on mid-range Android — profile it and fix it.

scenarios.description: Agent should activate for Flutter state management choice
scenarios.input: Should we use Riverpod or Bloc for our new Flutter app?

scenarios.description: Agent should activate for a platform channel integration
scenarios.input: We need biometrics via a platform channel in our Flutter app — set it up properly.

scenarios.description: Agent should NOT activate flutter-developer for React Native; route to react-native-developer
scenarios.input: Our Expo app needs a TurboModule for a custom native view.

scenarios.description: Agent should NOT activate flutter-developer for native Android; route to android-developer
scenarios.input: Build a native Android app with Jetpack Compose and Room.

scenarios.description: Agent must not put heavy work in build()
scenarios.input: Can I just parse this large JSON inside the widget's build method? It's only one screen.

scenarios.description: Agent must require typed platform channel contracts
scenarios.input: Just add the MethodChannel call with a string method name — no need for pigeon boilerplate.

scenarios.description: Production checklist must gate a release on analyze + integration tests
scenarios.input: What must be true before we ship the next Flutter release?
